comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
Thanks for the explanation, that makes sense.

Since I have some spare time while travelling I just had a look and did the merge/delete.

But yes, it is just do `git merge master` (where the local master branch must have the latest commits)

It should normally be pretty simple but it can be quite tricky if you get merge conflicts for example, so maybe that happened last time.

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
So to be precise wrt. git, this is the whole procedure:

```
git checkout master
git pull  # now we have the latest commits
git checkout selfdiffusion
git merge master  # if there are conflicts they'll need fixing
git push origin selfdiffusion
```
